facts.value: Groomed Gent Co. is the master brand, rooted in Lafayette, Louisiana and barbershop culture. Its positioning connects premium grooming with wellness, discipline and the whole man.

Legacy Reserve is the outer grooming line. Legacy Sanctum is the supplement and performance line; the same Sanctum name also describes a future digital and physical wellness vision. Distinguish products available on the retail site from future services.
Groomed Gent Collective is the existing ambassador project; CASSIUS is its intelligence identity. Commission rates, customer discounts and payout promises remain unapproved.
